Hotels returned for a Hoi An search (Myrtle Beach area, USA)

Our search for Hoi An, Vietnam ("hotels in Hoi An") returned US East Coast beach hotels, not hotels in Hoi An. By their names, their booking links and the same properties on our earlier pages, they are in Myrtle Beach and North Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, plus one in Virginia Beach, Virginia and one our Nags Head, North Carolina search also returned; three name no place but came back in the same list. Their prices are real and stay in the study's totals, but the study does not count Hoi An as one of its cities (corrected October 1, 2026).

Prices for the stay of Nov 5 to 7, 2026, as listed on October 1, 2026.

8 hotels from this search, all in the Myrtle Beach area, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on October 1, 2026 for Nov 5 to Nov 7, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for these hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 1, 2026 snapshot, at 12 of the 15 US East Coast hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Clicktrip.com at 3, Super.com at 3, Expedia.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1, the hotel's own site at 1, TravelUp at 1, trivago DEALS at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the rows the study's per-hotel CSV keeps under “Hoi An”, the market searched (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 5 of the 8 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 2, Bluepillow.com at 1, CheapTickets.com at 1, Clicktrip.com at 1, eDreams at 1, Expedia.com at 1, Hotels.com at 1, Orbitz.com at 1 and 2 other sites at 2 between them (a tie counts for each site). At the other 3, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line, and the study also counts the 7 named below that are not listed on this page. Taxes and fees at these hotels

At the 5 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 12% ($8 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at Sands Ocean Club Resort to 12% at Baywatch Resort in North Myrtle Beach by Dwell. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
